A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same sampling-aware quantization study. The main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison despite the changed title and layout.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation evaluations, component ablations, and qualitative results for SA-PTQ and SA-QLoRA in Tables 1–5 and the figures.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the ablations and appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: Mixed-Order Trajectory Alignment, SA-PTQ reconstruction, SA-QLoRA objectives, and sampler adaptations are unchanged. The mixstep progressive LoRA procedure in Appendix C.2 already appears in v1.

E1.justification: Both evaluate class-conditional ImageNet generation, unconditional LSUN-Bedroom and LSUN-Church generation, and MS-COCO text-to-image generation at the same resolutions. The newly cited diffusion language-model papers do not introduce additional evaluated tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across Tables 1–5 and the qualitative comparisons, including PTQ4DM, Q-Diffusion, PTQD, EfficientDM, BRECQ, and QLoRA. Newly cited dParallel and SparseD are not evaluated.

E3.justification: Both retain the same models, bit widths, metrics, guidance scales, and sampling procedures: 20 steps for ImageNet and 50 for LSUN and MS-COCO, with 50k image-benchmark samples and 30k text-to-image samples. Appendix training settings also match.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same trajectory-alignment and cosine-loss ablations. Appendix D preserves the same multi-order trajectory visualization and qualitative comparisons; no new robustness or sensitivity analysis appears.

E5.justification: The predefined-seed description for paired trajectory sampling is unchanged. Both report point estimates without repeated-run counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 match. For example, ImageNet W4A8 SA-QLoRA retains FID 8.55 and sFID 8.51, and its MS-COCO CLIP-Score remains 0.3017. The result images and reported findings are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, Appendix A assumptions, Runge-Kutta derivation, and quantization-error bounds are retained. Equation reformatting and equivalent derivative notation do not change the mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about sampling-aware quantization, mixed-order alignment, SA-PTQ and SA-QLoRA, and preservation of fast-sampling generation quality.

C2.justification: The explanations of directional error accumulation, probability-flow linearization, and low-bit generation failures remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or qualification of the method or results is added.

D1.justification: The abstract changes from promising a future code release to reporting public code and providing a repository URL. This adds concrete access information, although the PDFs alone cannot establish repository accessibility. Implementation and fine-tuning details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix B adds dParallel and SparseD, describing parallel decoding and sparse attention as complementary efficiency approaches, with corresponding bibliography entries. The central positioning against diffusion quantization and sampling methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 shortens the title, updates affiliations and author information, adds acknowledgements, and makes localized wording edits in the introduction and related work. Citation style changes to numbered references, and some appendix references become less specific; the section order and narrative remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: The manuscript is extensively reformatted from single-column to two-column text, with widespread resizing and relocation of figures and tables. Figure 1 moves onto the first page, diagrams and appendix image grids are enlarged, and Table 5's model header moves into its caption. These are substantial display changes without new scientific content.

improvement.justification: v2 replaces the code-release promise with a concrete access link and enlarges diagrams and appendix images, modestly improving reproducibility guidance and visual inspection. Some appendix cross-references become less precise, but the net benefit is limited and positive. The methods, theory, and experimental evidence remain unchanged.
